_comment: Per-file overrides for scripts/ingest-xref/ingest.mjs. Keys are exact filenames. Use 'skip' for non-cross files (product catalogs, SKU lists, doc registries, merged-cell layouts needing manual mapping); 'comp'/'tgt' to pin columns; 'wide' for one-key-to-many-brand matrices; 'filterCol'/'filterVal' to keep only verified rows; 'compBrand'/'tgtBrand'/'source'/'relation' for labels.
